name: Flier Inc.
summary: Flier Inc. creates and runs services that provide concise summaries of business books. Its platforms include Flier Book Labo, a community for book lovers, the main Flier service with summaries readable in about ten minutes, the Flier Official Channel with interviews on published works, and Flier Shelves, a personalized recommendation interface. Dating from 2013 in Tokyo, it is a subsidiary of MEDIA DO Co., Ltd.
